item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #SLPRSD
Issued at 04:55 PM 01 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Sorsogon(Irosin, SantaMagdalena, Matnog), #NorthernSamar(Catarman, Bobon, SanJose, Rosario, Biri, SanAntonio and Capul) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Sorsogon(Magallanes, Juban, Bulan), #NorthernSamar(Lavezares, Allen, Victoria, SanIsidro and LopeDeVega) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
